Key findings

  1. Leverage rose on both measures: total debt / EBITDA 4.8x to 5.0x, net debt / EBITDA 4.5x to 4.6x.
  2. Liquidity fell: committed resources went from 360 to 351 as 50 of the revolving facility was drawn.
  3. Debt due in 2027 grew from 26 to 150, with no refinancing stated.

Contrary evidence and what would change the view

Contrary evidence

Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA rose and cash rose by 41. Neither covenant is breached: EBITDA can fall 23.3% before the leverage limit.

What would change the view

A stated refinancing of the 150 due in 2027 would remove the nearest maturity.
